name: uv
description: Installs Astral's uv and uvx, optionally Python command-line tools, and keeps uv's Python interpreters and cache on a volume that survives rebuilds.

version.description: The uv release to install: latest, the newest release at build time, or one release as MAJOR.MINOR.PATCH.

toolsToInstall.description: Python command-line tools to install at build time, comma-separated, each a package name with at most one extra and one version constraint (needs uv 0.12.16 or later).
